architecture_contract.local_auxiliary_encoder: CorgiPlus encodes per-bin auxiliary tracks and concatenates them with DNA features before the transformer stack
architecture_contract.published_final_auxiliary_input: 2 stranded local total-RNA tracks plus 22 training-context mean-baseline tracks plus 2 RNA delta-from-baseline tracks, for 26 channels
architecture_contract.published_final_objective: multi-assay coverage loss plus delta-from-mean-baseline MSE; RNA output channels are masked because RNA is an input

identity_reconciliation.finding: The two Zenodo records contain byte-identical Corgi+ files. A restricted CPU tensor-schema inventory identified aux_encoder.0.weight with shape [128,26,1], excluding the incompatible 22- and 24-channel alternatives and binding the object to a 26-channel auxiliary input. State shape does not recover the missing input tensors, transforms, checkpoint-producing source or numeric reference.
identity_reconciliation.reproduction_gap: ekinda/corgi-reproduction pins an unavailable corgi gitlink and contains hard-coded /project paths. Its auto mode would not identify the official filename as corgiplusplus_rna, so it is not a portable checkpoint loader.

input_contract.global_context: The same 2,891 trans-regulator vector and normalization uncertainty as Regular Corgi.
input_contract.local_rna: Strand-specific total-RNA coverage across the full 524288-bp window at 64-bp bins, transformed exactly like Corgi training RNA tracks.
input_contract.mean_baseline: Per-assay, per-genomic-bin mean over training contexts only. It is a learned-data artifact and must be recomputed strictly inside each development training fold or frozen from the original checkpoint's training set if that exact object is recovered.
input_contract.rna_delta: Local RNA minus the corresponding two mean-baseline RNA channels for the published final Corgi+ design.
input_contract.warning: A gene-by-cell UMI matrix is not local stranded RNA coverage. Treat local coverage as structurally missing unless alignment-derived coverage exists and passes the exact transform contract; never encode missing coverage as zero.

license_audit.finding: The shared repository root LICENSE is Apache-2.0 while pyproject.toml declares MIT. The Corgi+ weight records are CC-BY-4.0 at record level.

loader_audit.high_level_api: corgiplus_pretrained exists only as a placeholder; predict, predict_regions and predict_regions_with_bigwig all raise NotImplementedError.
loader_audit.low_level_reproduction_code: Research scripts manually construct CorgiPlus with mode-specific auxiliary widths and strict or non-strict torch.load paths, but depend on unreleased mean baselines, masks, tissue tables, transformed tracks and absolute /project paths.

output_contract.activation: Conv1d_then_Softplus for the Corgi+ checkpoint; derived from exact output_head.0.weight and output_head.0.bias state keys and confirmed by strict restoration
output_contract.eligible_scoring_channels: For RNA-conditioned imputation, score epigenomic/accessibility outputs only. Do not score RNA channels 16-20 as predicted outcomes when their local total-RNA signal is supplied as input.
output_contract.primary_endpoint: conditional profile/multinomial deviance skill over a training-only cell-type mean, macro-averaged across held donor by cell type by genomic block
output_contract.transform_status: UNRESOLVED; exact original mean baseline, local RNA transforms, output transforms and released checkpoint mode are not published as a portable bundle

pretraining_contract.genomic_generalization: Corgi+ used all 14395 Corgi sequence windows for cross-cell-type imputation training/evaluation. It is not a held-sequence foundation checkpoint for this task.
pretraining_contract.selection: 102 samples with total RNA, DNase and at least one histone assay
pretraining_contract.warning: All project donor and genomic splits must still be imposed on local adaptation. The frozen upstream checkpoint has broad genomic-position and mean-baseline exposure.

reference_contract.rule: Require the Regular Corgi sequence parity suite plus exact 64-bp alignment of local RNA, baseline and outputs under shifts and reverse complement.

runtime_contract.compatibility_runtime: NVIDIA PyTorch 24.01 container, Python 3.10.12, torch 2.2.0a0+81ea7a4, CUDA 12.3, FlashAttention 2.0.4 plus the exact upstream rotary_emb 0.1 extension compiled for sm_89
runtime_contract.full_window_probe: Exact 26-channel construction, strict restore, synthetic-shape-only 524,288-bp plus 8,192-bin auxiliary forward to [1,22,6144], and shortened-window mixed-precision backward/SGD step passed on one NVIDIA L40S. Released biological auxiliary inputs and native numeric parity remain absent.
runtime_contract.released_config_portability: BLOCKED: config_corgiplus.py contains absolute /project paths and does not freeze the final auxiliary mode

safe_loading_contract.loading_rule: The downloaded object passed size, MD5 and SHA-256 verification, CPU-only torch.load(weights_only=True,map_location=cpu,mmap=True) tensor-schema inventory, and isolated no-network exact architecture restoration with no missing or surplus tensors. Use this safe exact path; never use the released unrestricted or non-strict paths.
safe_loading_contract.numeric_parity: Admission additionally requires official reference predictions or an upstream portable loader for local RNA, mean baseline, RNA delta, context, crop, TTA and all output channels. State-shape compatibility alone is not numeric parity.

source_evidence: The Nature Communications article, both official Zenodo records, ekinda/corgi at d84c00082da3d04eb05169e290e53f1c7da2b9c5 and ekinda/corgi-reproduction at 2367c42cf36630b7cf561eccc2e781abc22b36be were queried on 2026-08-22. On 2026-08-24 the official checkpoint was downloaded from Zenodo 18630048, byte-verified and safely inventoried without importing Corgi. No source_data.zip, training mean baseline, transformed local track or checkpoint-bound reference genome was acquired.

task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: primary conceptual fit but currently blocked; requires alignment-derived stranded local RNA and a training-only mean baseline, not gene-count matrices
task_fit.unified_model: blocked until a complete portable loader, exact checkpoint mode and all terms/input artifacts are resolved
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: not a primary sealed comparator: local RNA and mean baseline can encode the assayed locus, and the released model has no validated variant-scoring contract
